low_power_modes_summary.run_mode_when_SPE_clear: Module clock to SPI core gated off; registers still accessible.
low_power_modes_summary.wait_mode_with_SPISWAI_1: SPI clock generation turned off; in-progress transmission stops/resumes per master/slave role.
low_power_modes_summary.stop_mode: SPI inactive (module clock disabled); independent of SPISWAI; in-progress transmission stops (master) or continues if SCK driven (slave).

fields.notes: Power domain partitioning is deferred to SoC integration. The SPI block has no internal voltage domains.
